lounges.note: This record models Priority Pass access to the Business lounge only, not Senator access or airline-ticket entitlements. No direct Amex-only Lufthansa access is inferred. Dining service style and showers remain unverified.

qualityRating.summary: An October 2026 review of a late-September visit found dated decor but adequate seating, useful power points and a decent breakfast/lunch selection. It lacked the polish of newer Lufthansa lounges.

lounges.note: Ordinary domestic First and Delta status in Economy do not establish entry. Qualifying connections can permit earlier admission than the three-hour window modelled here. Partner premium tickets, Delta First status exceptions and arrival access remain follow-ups. The accessible current directory did not verify shower availability or dining style.

qualityRating.summary: A historical March 2022 review praised the generous food selection and found a seat despite crowds, but described tired interiors. Reassessment of the current experience is needed.
